title: CFTC Again Probes Polymarket Over Whether It Let Americans Trade
summary: Bitcoin Magazine CFTC Again Probes Polymarket Over Whether It Let Americans Trade The CFTC is reportedly probing whether Polymarket broke its 2022 settlement by letting US users onto its offshore platform. This post CFTC Again Probes Polymarket Over Whether It Let Americans Trade first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
